coreQueryPageProvider.name: DOCUCENTRAL_BY_STATUS
coreQueryPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM DCControlledDocument WHERE ecm:currentLifeCycleState = ? AND ecm:isVersion = 0 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0

coreQueryPageProvider.name: DOCUCENTRAL_MY_QUEUE
coreQueryPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM DCControlledDocument WHERE ecm:currentLifeCycleState IN ('draft', 'review') AND (dcx:owner = '?' OR dcx:reviewers = '?') AND ecm:isVersion = 0 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0

coreQueryPageProvider.name: DOCUCENTRAL_OVERDUE_REVIEW
coreQueryPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM DCControlledDocument WHERE ecm:currentLifeCycleState = 'published' AND dcx:nextReviewDate < DATE '?' AND ecm:isVersion = 0 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0
